# Faultline

> Deterministic CI failure diagnosis CLI. Analyzes build logs against 173 evidence-backed playbooks to identify and explain failures — no AI or LLM required.

Faultline reads a CI log, scores it against bundled playbooks, and surfaces the most likely failure with diagnosis, fix steps, and validation. Primary commands: `faultline analyze`, `faultline workflow`, `faultline list`, `faultline explain`, `faultline fix`.

Coding agents: read `AGENTS.md` and `SYSTEM.md` before making changes. Run `make test` after code changes, `make review` after playbook changes, and `make docs-generate` after adding or modifying playbooks.

## Docs

- [SYSTEM.md](SYSTEM.md): Architecture, product shape, primary commands, internal package boundaries, and core entities
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent operating rules, scope safety, engineering constraints, and completion standard
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Workflow, fixture handling, sanitization, and pull request guidelines
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): Internal package responsibilities and data flow
- [docs/playbooks.md](docs/playbooks.md): Playbook schema, authoring guide, match signals, and scoring
- [docs/workflows.md](docs/workflows.md): Workflow command output, agent workflow mode, and structured JSON response shape
- [docs/detectors.md](docs/detectors.md): Detector types, evidence scoring, and signal extraction
- [docs/signatures.md](docs/signatures.md): Signature-based matching and pattern authoring
- [docs/silent-failures.md](docs/silent-failures.md): Silent failure detection — jobs that exit 0 but produce wrong or empty output
- [docs/release-boundary.md](docs/release-boundary.md): Shipped user narrative, feature gating, and what is or is not in the default release

## Failure catalog

- [docs/failures/llms.txt](docs/failures/llms.txt): Machine-readable index of all 173 failure playbooks, grouped by category, with one-line descriptions and direct links to each page
- [docs/failures/catalog/README.md](docs/failures/catalog/README.md): Human-readable catalog index — all 173 playbooks with diagnosis and fix links
